T.why: true NTC temperature, -20..+60 degC (K because the law has 1/T)

Vsh.why: self-heating is evaluated at Vcc = 3.6 V (continuous measurement)

xn.why: node ratio x = Rx/(Rx+Rp) at the true temperature

E_R25.why: |T_inferred - T| from R25 at its tolerance limit (worse sign)

E_Rpar.why: same, from the parallel resistor (about 0 when none)

Etot.why: sum of the absolute error items

define.dAdcp: ln(((1 + Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R)/Rxn)/(1 - Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R)/RP.R))) + ln((1 - Dq)/(1 - Dq*((1 + Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R)/Rxn)/(1 - Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R)/RP.R))))
define.dAdcm: ln(((1 - Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R)/Rxn)/(1 + Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R)/RP.R))) + ln((1 - Dq)/(1 - Dq*((1 - Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R)/Rxn)/(1 + Dxa*(Rxn + RP.R)/RP.R))))

laws.source: divider: x = Rx/(Rx+Rp), Rx = R_NTC || R_par, R_NTC = R25 exp(B(1/T-1/T0))
change of inferred T when R25 sits at +-tolerance, others nominal (hand-derived delta)

laws.zfl: E_B == max(max((0 - T*T*(dBp)/(NTC.B + T*(dBp))), 0 - (0 - T*T*(dBp)/(NTC.B + T*(dBp)))), max((0 - T*T*(dBm)/(NTC.B + T*(dBm))), 0 - (0 - T*T*(dBm)/(NTC.B + T*(dBm)))))
E_Rp == max(max((0 - T*T*(dRpp)/(NTC.B + T*(dRpp))), 0 - (0 - T*T*(dRpp)/(NTC.B + T*(dRpp)))), max((0 - T*T*(dRpm)/(NTC.B + T*(dRpm))), 0 - (0 - T*T*(dRpm)/(NTC.B + T*(dRpm)))))
E_Rpar == max(max((0 - T*T*(dRparp)/(NTC.B + T*(dRparp))), 0 - (0 - T*T*(dRparp)/(NTC.B + T*(dRparp)))), max((0 - T*T*(dRparm)/(NTC.B + T*(dRparm))), 0 - (0 - T*T*(dRparm)/(NTC.B + T*(dRparm)))))
E_adc == max(max((0 - T*T*(dAdcp)/(NTC.B + T*(dAdcp))), 0 - (0 - T*T*(dAdcp)/(NTC.B + T*(dAdcp)))), max((0 - T*T*(dAdcm)/(NTC.B + T*(dAdcm))), 0 - (0 - T*T*(dAdcm)/(NTC.B + T*(dAdcm)))))
laws.source: ADC +-(TUE+0.5 LSB) in ratio units, inverted by the firmware
P_NTC = V_NTC^2/R_NTC, dT_sh = P_NTC/delta; V_NTC = Vcc*x

laws.zfl: Etot == E_R25 + E_B + E_Rp + E_Rpar + E_adc + Tsh
laws.source: error stack: sum of absolute items

requirements.why: R1: total error <= 0.4 K for T in [273.15,293.15] K
R1: total error <= 0.4 K for T in [293.15,313.15] K
R1: total error <= 1 K for T in [253.15,273.15] K
R1: total error <= 1 K for T in [313.15,333.15] K
